items.q: The things that he used to say to George Wein, you know, when Wein was in uniform

ctx.x: Yeah. You squirm in your seat, you know. Until today, this is what I think... The things that he used to say to George Wein, you know, when Wein was in uniform; you know, I didn't particularly... He was so bitter. I don't know... You know, the poor boy squirmed, you know...!
After you had this period with Frank, and you joined Kirby... Now, Billy Kyle...
